thread.title: Cubs Rockies Baseball

author: David Zalubowski - AP
title: Cubs Rockies Baseball
text:
• Sterlin Thompson hit a pinch single off Daniel Palencia's 100-mph fastball in the ninth inning to give the Colorado Rockies a 3-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs on Wednesday night.
• It was the seventh career RBI for Thompson, the 24-year-old rookie from nearby Longmont.
• Thompson's single to right field with runners on first and third and no outs came after Ian Happ hit a 424-foot solo home run off Antonio Senzatela in the top of the ninth to tie it.
• TJ Rumfield hit his eighth homer of the season for Colorado, a two-run shot to right field for a 2-1 lead in the eighth.
• After blowing the save opportunity, Senzatela (6-0) picked up the win.
• Palencia (1-1) took the loss.
